title: Mara and the Thorn
author: Beatrix Kavanagh
blurb: Freya Hartwell, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
